appearance_facts.fact: A pale-yellow wedge occupies the top-left quadrant, bounded by a vertical radius at 12 o'clock and a diagonal radius toward the upper-left; the white label 'Samsung (55 %)' sits inside it.
An orange wedge spans from the 12 o'clock vertical radius down to a radius toward the lower-right; the white label 'Others (10 %)' is centered within it.
A reddish-orange wedge fills the bottom-right area; the white label 'Apple (15 %)' is centered within it.
A red wedge occupies the left and lower-left area; the white label 'Xiaomi (20 %)' is centered within it.

The pale-yellow 'Samsung' wedge visually subtends the largest central angle, followed by the red 'Xiaomi' wedge, then the reddish-orange 'Apple' wedge, then the orange 'Others' wedge, which is the smallest.

printed_facts.fact: Title text reads 'Smartphone Market Share in Europe'.

public_definitions: option_labels: 'Select Samsung as the current market leader'; 'Select Others as the current market leader'; 'Select Xiaomi as the current market leader'.
page_instructions (form): 'Use the Europe smartphone market share dashboard to identify the brand for market-leader follow-up.'
companion field 'Market region' option 'Europe' is available (required select).
uncertain: The printed percentages (55 + 20 + 15 + 10 = 100) are internally consistent, but the rendered wedge for 'Samsung (55 %)' appears visually smaller than a true 55% sector would be; the printed label is taken as authoritative for the share value.
No explicit legend or axis is present; brand-to-slice binding is taken solely from the in-slice text labels.
